maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from placing temporary nurses, allied staff and locums at hospitals, plus workforce software; this is staffing, not repair or servicing.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are mainly private and nonprofit hospitals and health systems paying for travel nurse and clinician staffing, not government payers.

serial_acquirer.reason: Growth comes mainly from selling staffing, language services and WorkWise technology; acquisitions have been occasional rather than a steady roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Core business is healthcare staffing, where hospitals can switch among competing agencies; the WorkWise software adds some stickiness but is secondary.
